prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1437; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear quarter panel and left taillight assembly show crush and tearing consistent with the reported impact while turning left, and the pattern of deformation follows the direction of force described. Adjacent trim and the bumper bracket also show matching marks. The proposed repair plan covers panel straightening, replacement of the lamp housing, refinishing and recalibration of the blind-spot sensor, and the labor hours listed fit the scope of this damage. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from the records reviewed. Two similar line items entered on the same day are being verified against the shop's invoice history before payment is released.
